prompt: Which algorithmic technique finds the shortest path between all pairs of vertices in a weighted graph with possible negative edges (no negative cycles) in O(V³) time?
explanation: Floyd-Warshall is a dynamic programming algorithm using recurrence `dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j])` with three nested loops over V vertices, running in O(V³) time.
